reads_against.argmap: What exactly is dvaitādhivāsa? → Dvaita-residence is epistemic (ākhyāti-mātra), so its removal is vikalpa-work, not thing-work.
c1_essence: Dvaitādhivāsa is no separate thing: mere own-nature-manifestation — so removal is by concept.
